top_signals.title: Putin Signs Decree to Seize Control of Nestle Assets in Russia
top_signals.summary: Russia seized control of the local assets of Swiss food giant Nestle SA and French supermarket chain Auchan, placing their stakes in Russian businesses under temporary administration.

top_signals.title: Connecticut Surplus Deposits to State Pensions Top $11B
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg's Martin Braun joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg real Yield." Connecticut transferred about $1.3 billion in excess revenue this latest fiscal year to underfunded state employees’ and teachers’ pensions, bringing surplus deposits to more than $11 billion over the last seven years, state Treasurer Erick Russell said Tuesday.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: NYC Transit Agency Prepares $785M Mansion Tax Bond Sale
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg's Michelle Kaske joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." New York City’s transit network is planning to offer $785 million of debt backed by a levy on sales of luxury real estate.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Dispersion In High Yield Idiosyncratic: Steinbach
top_signals.summary:
Margaret Steinbach, fixed income asset class lead at Capital Group, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." They discuss the gap between spreads between CCC and single B bonds in the high yield market.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
